name: Flight Master's Whistle has its 30 minute cooldown (COA-7253)
contract: Using the Flight Master's Whistle (item 10) casts spell 158, whose client data gives it a 30 minute cooldown. Since #9460 the use only opens the flight master choice; the cooldown starts when the chosen retreat (spell 2485, category 101 with a 30 minute category cooldown) completes, so after the retreat the whistle is on cooldown.

steps.label: the whistle is on its 30 minute cooldown
